info.name: FoC User Service
info.description:
Every route of the User Service, ordered so the whole collection runs top to bottom in the Collection Runner with no manual step: the OTPs are read out of Mailpit's HTTP API by a pre-request script.

Needs the compose stack up (`docker compose up`) - the service on baseUrl and Mailpit on mailpitUrl.

Each address gets three OTP requests per ten minutes, shared across register, resend and forgot - so every folder here owns its own address and spends that budget deliberately. Every address is generated fresh per run, so the runner is safe to press repeatedly.

The Admin folder claims the bootstrap admin: set adminEmail to USER_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL, and start the service on an empty database so the bootstrap has run. It resets that admin's password every run (the new one is left in adminPassword), which spends the admin address's OTP budget, so the full collection runs at most three times per ten minutes.

AI Assistance Disclosure: Tool: Claude Code (model: Claude Opus 5), date: 2026-09-28. Scope: generated the requests, the assertions and the Mailpit OTP lookup. Author review: the full collection run green against the compose stack.

2026-09-28 (model: Claude Opus 5.5): automated the Profile and Admin folders - Mailpit OTP lookups, assertions, a fresh account per folder, and claiming the bootstrap admin. Author review: the full collection run green under newman against the compose stack (70 requests, 101 assertions).

AI Assistance Disclosure (the Profile and Admin requests): Tool: Claude Code (model: Claude Opus 5), date: 2026-09-26. Scope: generated the collection for the three sign-up routes. 2026-09-28 (model: Claude Sonnet 5): added List users (admin) and Change role (admin) (Step 10 - these routes were marked Postman-verified in admin.controller.ts/admin.service.ts, but the requests used for that were never saved into this collection), the six Step 12 requests (Request OTP through Deactivate account), and Reactivate user (admin) (Step 13). Author review: the six Step 12 requests were exercised via Postman against the compose stack on 2026-09-28 (all endpoints, including the retry-with-the-same-code behaviour on Change email - request and Change password) - see /ai/usage-log.md. Reactivate user (admin) was exercised the same way on 2026-09-28 (deactivate then reactivate, 404 for an unknown id, 409 NOT_DEACTIVATED for an already-ACTIVE target). List users (admin) and Change role (admin) (Step 10) are still unverified through this file specifically, even though the routes themselves were separately confirmed working via ad hoc Postman requests when Step 10 was built.

2026-10-16 (Claude Code, model: Claude Opus 5.5): copied into refactored-user-service/postman and added the Validation folder (per-endpoint 400 cases for the new DTOs). The existing requests and assertions are unchanged: each was checked against the new fields.ts rules and still holds. Author review: pending Deanson.

Only @u.nus.edu and @nus.edu.sg may hold an account. Subdomains are not accepted either: evil.u.nus.edu is a domain we do not control, so the match is exact. At least 8 characters with a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter and a digit. The ceiling is 72 bytes, because that is all bcrypt reads - two passwords sharing a 72-byte prefix would otherwise verify against the same hash.
